skills.distinctive_value: Paper-type-dependent narrative weight and an explicit limitation–goal–challenge–module–contribution chain; real recurring example; natural prose by default, outline only when requested.

features.label: Technique versus new problem positioning
features.integration_decision: Choose a primary contribution and adapt argument weight; preserve benchmark/theory/negative-result routes.

features.label: Six logical questions and challenge/module/contribution trace
features.integration_decision: Use flexible many-to-many traceability; paragraph count, contribution count and section-number formatting are not universal validity gates.

features.label: Verified recurring example
features.integration_decision: Link real input/output records; no invented deployment, failure, mechanism or quantified impact. Upstream worked examples are not independently validated here.

features.label: Internal work plan separate from deliverable prose

sections: What must never appear in the output

features.integration_decision: Persist inspectable planning summaries separately; deliver natural manuscript prose without workflow tags. Work records retain gaps.

features.label: Fixed six paragraphs, citation density and unsupported qualitative improvement fallback
features.integration_decision: Keep context-specific heuristics only; without observed comparison omit improves over prior baselines. Never invent structure or evidence to meet counts.

skills.distinctive_value: Scope/evidence/blueprint/draft/review/delivery phases, explicit source limits, per-section contracts, and independent citation verification with honest fallback.

features.label: Evidence Map with cannot-support field and paragraph provenance gate

sections: 1. Legitimate sources and the evidence hierarchy

features.integration_decision: Project existing IDs into an evidence map. Full-text availability never permits arbitrary claims; every sentence needs the actual observation, locator, scope and inference.

features.label: Paradigm and section-specific blueprint
features.integration_decision: Select structure by research method and venue. Keep observation and proposed mechanism distinguishable even when Results/Discussion are combined.

features.label: Independent citation verification ladder and error distinctions

sections: 3. When to trigger the independent pass
4. What the verifier does with each citation

features.integration_decision: Preserve VERIFIED/METADATA_MISMATCH/NOT_FOUND/OVERCLAIM/INCONCLUSIVE semantics. A fresh reviewer gets manuscript and sources, no desired verdict. Offline full text can still support actual local content; no false claim of live verification.

features.label: Clean delivery with independent working artifacts

sections: What must never appear in the output

features.integration_decision: Keep ledgers and missing inputs outside clean manuscript; disclosure length follows material issues, not a universal three-line limit.

features.label: Citation/bibliography reciprocity and supplied style
features.integration_decision: Honor user/venue style and real source identities. No default English override of an explicit Chinese artifact request; no reference-count quota.

features.label: L1 supports any claim; planned-to-preliminary; substantial margin with missing evidence

sections: 1. Legitimate sources and the evidence hierarchy

features.integration_decision: Use Atlas evidence scope and observed/planned distinction. User confirmation is source provenance, not a scientific validity certificate; speculative mechanism belongs in an explicit hypothesis record.

skills.distinctive_value: Conservative editing, explicit meaning-risk changes, before/after comparison, file diff, term-consistent translation and processing coverage.

features.label: Meaning preservation and explicit scientific edit risk

sections: The overriding rule: stay faithful to the author's meaning

features.integration_decision: Track numbers, units, denominator, direction, scope, negation, quantifiers and causal strength. Pure language edits proceed; meaningful scientific changes receive explicit diff and reasoning, with existing authorization honored.

features.label: Evidence-calibrated verbs and AI-tone review

sections: Calibration: do not let the author overclaim

features.integration_decision: Use a contextual wording check, not a banned-token filter. Softening a verb cannot make missing evidence adequate; do not erase supported conclusions for stylistic conformity.

features.label: Proposition-preserving Chinese-to-English rewriting
features.integration_decision: Maintain technical terms and proposition relations; do not infer causation while restoring implicit logic. Separate clean prose from author notes.

features.label: Full processing coverage and unreadable-element disclosure

sections: Working on files versus pasted text

features.integration_decision: Record every processed section, formula/table/image exceptions and the exact input/output versions.

features.label: Local handbook prohibition and pseudo-grammar hard rules
features.integration_decision: Do not inherit a blanket AI/translation ban while claiming to provide drafting. Multi-clause sentences, grammatical verbs, American/British punctuation and valid terms are not automatically errors. Preserve author responsibility and current applicable venue requirements.

skills.license_declaration: CC-BY-4.0 in SKILL frontmatter; root LICENSE says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Preserve discrepancy.
skills.distinctive_value: Separate motivated examples, method overviews and measured-result figures; concrete layout and label guidance plus design/verification boundaries.

features.label: Figure purpose and paradigm selection
features.integration_decision: Make a brief with claim ID, verified example, method names, reading order and evidence boundaries. Three core types are useful defaults, not an exhaustive ontology.

features.label: Reproducible measured-result figures with explicit uncertainty

sections: 常见的图表类型与适用场景

features.integration_decision: Bind data, aggregation, denominator, units, run set, uncertainty definition and plot-code versions. Color/shape/line encoding and caption claims must reflect actual conditions.

features.label: Universal vector-only and automatic nonzero axis rules
features.integration_decision: Use vector for appropriate geometry; raster evidence/crops may be necessary. Choose baseline by visual encoding; a bar's length must not manufacture apparent effect size.

features.label: Scatter direction must follow the actual metric

sections: 常见的图表类型与适用场景 / 散点图

features.integration_decision: The handbook uses inference time on X yet calls upper-right faster and better. Time-minimizing superiority is toward lower X; throughput/maximization has another orientation. Never alter axes/data to place Ours in a predetermined corner.

features.label: Actual visual verification and capability-aware tooling
features.integration_decision: Use pass/fail/not-checked/not-applicable. Image inspection can assess legibility but cannot certify exact font points or vector source. Tool suggestions do not authorize installation or upload.

skills.license_declaration: MIT declared by README.md and README.zh-CN.md; linked local LICENSE absent from this reviewed text snapshot; SKILL has no license field
skills.distinctive_value: Visible-element and arrow inventories, fidelity-based medium selection, text-box containment, bounded batch scheduling and mandatory visual comparison.

features.label: Per-element inventory and medium selection
features.integration_decision: Use native text/structure, matched simple SVG/native icons and source crops for complex visuals; record status and editing scope for each item.

features.label: Arrows, geometry and typography containment
features.integration_decision: Check source/target, direction, anchors, path, arrowheads, layering and semantic role; resize containing boxes when text changes.

features.label: Batch manifest and exclusive work sets with serial fallback
features.integration_decision: Require per-item outputs and coordinator inspection; parallelism is scheduling only. Preserve existing files/manual edits and process only authorized targets.

features.label: Technical validity is separate from visual acceptance
features.integration_decision: XML/check/export success is insufficient. Compare full-size rendered output with source and verify every visible item. Unresolved defects or no preview mean draft/not complete.

features.label: Fidelity versus improvement; preserve user edits
features.integration_decision: Faithful reconstruction and scientific/layout redesign are separate versions when authorized; do not silently change wording, meaning or topology.

features.label: Bundled helpers and recommended model/runtime
features.integration_decision: Only optional invocation after actual code/dependency review and authorization. No helper code imported, no runtime installed or recommended model efficacy established here.

conflicts.tension: Fixed six paragraphs, contribution/reference quotas versus task-specific research structure
conflicts.decision: Retain logical checks, adapt counts/ordering, use many-to-many mappings.

conflicts.tension: Natural clean manuscript versus inspectable research records
conflicts.decision: Clean manuscript plus separate evidence/blueprint/notes; never hide missing work.

conflicts.tension: L1 full text/data supports any claim
conflicts.decision: Source access is not unlimited support; exact content, locator, scope and inference cap claims.

conflicts.tension: Unexecuted/planned results described as preliminary results or qualitative success
conflicts.decision: Plans remain predictions. Preliminary requires observed evidence; qualitative comparison also requires comparison.

conflicts.tension: Results interpret why and Discussion invents plausible mechanism despite stricter hard rules
conflicts.decision: Adapt section format but separate observation from hypothesis; new mechanism clearly untested, never fabricated as a finding.
Do not silently strengthen or weaken. Use explicit before/after reasoning for scientific correction; honor existing authorization.

conflicts.tension: Polish parenthetical author notes versus no embedded drafting placeholders
conflicts.decision: Keep author notes separate by default; annotated copy only when requested.

conflicts.tension: Handbook blanket AI/translation ban versus drafting/translation skills
conflicts.decision: Explicitly reject global inheritance of local ban. User-authorized assistance retains author responsibility, evidence and applicable venue constraints.

conflicts.tension: Vector-only design rules versus fidelity-driven complex-image crops
conflicts.decision: Separate measured plots and diagram reconstruction; allow disclosed mixed media with editable text/structure.

conflicts.tension: Generic nonzero axis and upper-right Ours rule versus honest encoding/direction
conflicts.decision: Specify meaning, unit and optimize direction for every axis. Do not truncate length encodings to exaggerate; latency minimization differs from throughput maximization.

conflicts.tension: Inspection/check/export success versus source-format, point-size and fidelity claims
conflicts.decision: Record technical, visual and semantic checks separately. Exact pt/vector status needs source metadata; unchecked is not pass.
Reconstruct source faithfully; preserve manual edits; redesign separately if authorized. Do not silently change labels or arrows.

conflicts.tension: Citation suspension counts as resolved versus Final no pending claims
conflicts.decision: Suspended is a documented next action, not evidence. Critical unresolved claims prevent readiness labels.

conflicts.tension: Fixed DB improvement/dataset requirements and positive-results framing
conflicts.decision: Do not inherit 50%/10%/3-dataset thresholds, baseline transitivity or ablation-as-proof. Evaluate evidence and contribution type; preserve useful negative findings.
